pages.title: NothingButA Tools
pages.meta_description: A clean directory of simple NothingButA utility tools.
pages.h1: One clear tool for one clear job.

pages.title: NothingButA Break-Even Calculator
pages.meta_description: Calculate the break-even point for a product, service, or project by comparing fixed costs, variable costs, and price per sale.

pages.title: NothingButA Car Payment Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate a monthly car payment using price, down payment, trade-in, interest rate, and loan term before shopping.

pages.title: NothingButA Churn Rate Calculator
pages.meta_description: Calculate churn rate from customers lost and starting customers so you can measure retention, customer loss, and business stability.

pages.title: NothingButA Concrete Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate concrete volume for slabs, posts, and small projects using dimensions so you can plan material needs.

pages.title: NothingButA Conversion Rate Calculator
pages.meta_description: Calculate conversion rate from visitors, leads, signups, or sales so you can measure how well traffic turns into results.

pages.title: NothingButA Days Between Dates Calculator
pages.meta_description: Count the days between two dates for deadlines, trips, projects, billing periods, or planning timelines.

pages.title: Nothing But A Debt Payoff Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate debt payoff time, interest paid, interest saved, and months saved from extra monthly payments.
pages.h1: See your debt payoff path in seconds.

pages.title: NothingButA Discount Calculator
pages.meta_description: Use the Discount Calculator to calculate sale price, discount amount, and final cost. Enter your numbers to get a clearer result for planning, comparison, or budgeting.

pages.title: NothingButA Emergency Fund Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate an emergency fund target from monthly expenses and months of coverage so you can plan a savings buffer.

pages.title: NothingButA Flooring Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate flooring material needs from room size and waste allowance so you can plan boards, tiles, or square footage.

pages.title: NothingButA Freelance Rate Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate an hourly freelance rate from income goals, billable hours, expenses, and tax buffer.

pages.title: NothingButA Hourly to Salary Calculator
pages.meta_description: Convert an hourly wage into an estimated yearly salary. Enter your hourly rate, weekly hours, and weeks worked to see annual pay before taxes.

pages.title: NothingButA Loan Early Payoff Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate how extra loan payments may change payoff timing and interest so you can compare early payoff plans.

pages.title: NothingButA Mortgage Payment Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate a monthly mortgage payment using loan amount, interest rate, loan term, taxes, insurance, and other housing costs before you shop.

pages.title: NothingButA Paint Coverage Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate paint needed from room size, coverage, and coats so you can plan cans before starting a project.

pages.title: NothingButA Paycheck Take-Home Estimator
pages.meta_description: Estimate take-home pay from gross income using pay frequency, taxes, deductions, and withholding assumptions before planning your budget.

pages.title: NothingButA Percentage Change Calculator
pages.meta_description: Calculate percentage change between two values to measure increases, decreases, growth, or price changes.

pages.title: NothingButA Recipe Scale Calculator
pages.meta_description: Scale recipe ingredients up or down by servings so you can adjust batches without recalculating each item by hand.

pages.title: NothingButA Rent Affordability Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate how much rent may fit your monthly budget using income, debt, expenses, and savings goals before you choose a place.

pages.title: NothingButA Simple ROI Calculator
pages.meta_description: Estimate return on investment by comparing gain, cost, and profit so you can judge whether a project, campaign, or purchase is worth it.

pages.title: NothingButA Sales Tax Calculator
pages.meta_description: Calculate sales tax and final price from subtotal and tax rate so you can estimate checkout cost before buying.

pages.title: NothingButA Savings Goal Calculator
pages.meta_description: Plan a savings goal by entering your target amount, current savings, monthly contribution, and timeline to estimate progress.

pages.title: NothingButA Time Card Calculator
pages.meta_description: Use the Time Card Calculator to add work hours, breaks, and totals for a pay period. Enter your numbers to get a clearer result for planning, comparison, or budgeting.

pages.title: NothingButA Tip Calculator
pages.meta_description: Use the Tip Calculator to split a tip and bill total quickly and clearly. Enter your numbers to get a clearer result for planning, comparison, or budgeting.

pages.title: NothingButA Unit Price Calculator
pages.meta_description: Use the Unit Price Calculator to compare package prices by unit cost before buying. Enter your numbers to get a clearer result for planning, comparison, or budgeting.
